text:
Alex: Heads-up — found a provider deprecation warning during the module-refactor run. terraform plan flagged provider.kubernetes v2 -> v3 deprecations and some modules now expect aliased providers. Also noticed a couple services failing in staging because k8s secret paths changed after the manifest reorg. anyone looked at this yet?

Sam: I saw the plan warnings earlier. looks like the module split hoisted the provider into root, but some child modules still pin older constraints. we should either: hoist and alias or pin compatible provider versions in the module.

Maria: @Sam +1. For the short term we can alias. Example:
```hcl
provider "kubernetes" {
  alias = "legacy"
  version = "~> 2.11"
}

module "foo" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@.../tf-mod-foo.git"
  providers = { kubernetes = kubernetes.legacy }
}
```
This lets us migrate module-by-module.

Lee: For lockfile: after we update providers we should regenerate the lockfile from root so the registry mirrors the new pins. run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` (and other platforms) then `terraform init -upgrade -lockfile=write`. watch out for provider mirror changes.

Alex: nice. Does that approach require module publishes/versions to be bumped? I want to avoid a big churn for the release today.

Sam: If we alias and set `providers` mapping in the root call, modules don't need new semver immediately. but if module code itself calls `provider "kubernetes" { }` with constraints that conflict you might still get plan errors. quick check is to run a recursive `terraform init` in the affected stack with `-upgrade` on a branch.

Maria: Also the k8s secretpath problem — during the manifest reorg the secret names moved from `redwood/service/xyz` -> `redwood/services/xyz` (plural). the workloads mount the old path in the deployment `envFrom` so they fail to find keys. short patch is to add a compatibility symlink secret or create a second secret using the old name in staging. longer: update kustomize overlays and deploy pipeline.

Lee: I can push a staging quickfix: duplicate the secret with the old name via `kubectl -n staging get secret redwood/services/xyz -o yaml | yq '.metadata.name = "redwood/service/xyz"' | kubectl apply -f -` (will do it as a one-off).

InfraBot: CI:tf-plan #3124 — provider-warning: kubernetes v3 deprecation (affected modules: tf-mod-foo, tf-mod-bar). See https://ci.redwood.example/3124 :eyes:

Alex: thanks @InfraBot and Lee. Sam/Maria — can you two coordinate a minimal PR for aliasing + lockfile regen? ideally keep to one commit: provider alias + regenerate lockfile + add a short note in the module README about target provider versions. I'll run the staging patch first.

Sam: I'll open a draft PR against infra/terraform-root. going to: 1) add aliased provider block, 2) update module calls mapping, 3) run `terraform providers lock` for linux_amd64 and darwin_arm64, 4) commit .terraform.lock.hcl. will tag @Maria for manifest changes.

Maria: I'll update the kustomize overlays to canonicalize the secret path and add a migration note. will coordinate with Lee on the one-off until PR is merged. planning to keep the k8s change in a separate PR so terraform change is minimal.

Lee: I'll do the staging secret shadow now and then run the smoke tests. ping me here if anything breaks — I'll roll back. :thumbsup:

Alex: plan looks good. small checklist for the PR: 
- include `providers` mapping for each affected module call
- add `provider "kubernetes" { alias = "legacy" }` comment explaining deprecation
- regenerate `.terraform.lock.hcl` and include which platforms were locked
- update CHANGES.md / module README with migration steps

Sam: putting the draft up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/981 (WIP). please review when you have a sec. cc @Maria @Lee

Maria: reviewing now. pulling plan artifacts to confirm no drift in other stacks.

Lee: staging shadow applied, smoke tests running. so far services come up and env shows the expected keys. will report back in ~10m.

InfraBot: smoke-tests/staging #4512 — all tests passed (10m).

Alex: awesome. thanks team. merging workflow: once Sam's PR is green and Maria's k8s PR is ready we can roll both to staging together and then production on next deployment window.

Sam: noted. will add a short rollback note too. final link when ready. :rocket:
